reason: I'd use the free visit on a Saturday and probably pay for a drop-in once after that, since we're out on weekends anyway and a calm, capped-attendance place sounds nice. But we'd only go once or twice a month, so it's drop-in only, never a membership.
objection: We'd go once or twice a month, not enough to justify a membership, and $16 on a weekend adds up when there are free parks and library story times. I also need to see that it's actually not crowded on Saturdays.
would_change_my_mind: A weekend drop-in closer to $12 or a 5-visit pack that doesn't expire quickly would make me go more often.
